name: proto-upstream-copy-below-a-directory-outside-the-buf-modules
description: A copy of an upstream schema kept below a directory outside every buf module, beside the module's own copy of that upstream path, is no schema file the build reads: every import of the path reads the module's copy, so the outside copy publishes nothing and a schema-unparsed note names it. Since a schema file not read cleanly, a shadowed one included, may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
